title: White Wonder Cucumber - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Heirloom White Cucumber
description:
Grow Your Own Unique Creamy-White Cucumbers – Perfect for Salads & Pickling!


KEY FEATURES
• Unique creamy-white fruits, 20-25cm long
• Heirloom variety with excellent eating quality
• Crisp, mild, sweet flesh with no bitterness
• Early and productive, suitable for fresh use and pickling
• Vigorous, trailing/climbing habit, easy to grow


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Cucumis sativus 'White Wonder'
Colour: Creamy white to pale ivory
Season: July - September (Harvest Period)
Growth Habit: Vigorous, trailing/climbing
Flavour: Mild, sweet, crisp, refreshing
Time to Harvest: 50-70 days from sowing


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun (6-8 hours daily minimum)
Soil: Fertile, humus-rich, well-drained loamy soil (pH 6.0-7.0)
Watering: Consistent moisture, 1-2 inches per week. Keep soil evenly moist but not waterlogged. Water at soil level.
Spacing: 30-45 cm between plants, 80-100 cm between rows
Height: Trailing/climbing (can reach several feet with support)
Spread: Up to 1.2 metres
Hardiness: Thrives in zones 3-10 (plant after last frost)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant out in May after all risk of frost has passed, ensuring warm, sunny, sheltered conditions.
• Provide support (trellis or stakes) for climbing plants to improve fruit quality and ease of harvest.
• Water regularly and deeply, especially during dry spells, keeping the soil consistently moist.
• Mulch around the base of plants to retain soil moisture and suppress weeds.
• Harvest fruits regularly when 15-25cm long and fully white, to encourage continuous production. Pick every 2-3 days.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants


DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
